digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, Pass-1 finder model selection
propositions: Pass-1 (the blocking findings generator) silently runs on haiku instead of opus because plan-review.yaml declares trivial in model_ladder rung 0 and b690 now honours req.config where PydanticAIRunner previously discarded it
The regression is undiscoverable by offline tests because they substitute FunctionModel/FakeRunner, bypassing the actual model selection seam

Before 2026-06-27, 115 plan-review runs generated findings on opus; after _verifier_cfg landed (2026-06-27), zero opus runs and 2710+ sonnet runs, a total permanent changeover caused by downgraded cfg cascading to Pass-1
Pass-1 must run on frontier/opus to match pre-2026-06-27 behaviour; Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach must remain on standard/sonnet per _verifier_cfg intent
Prerequisite finder's bin packing sizes to cfg.model (haiku 200k) instead of opus (1M), causing false context-limit escalations that burn tokens unnecessarily
The YAML has declared trivial for five weeks while sonnet actually ran; restoring frontier + b690's req.config honoring is a restoration not a new design choice
